newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shionogi to market U.S. antifibrotic drug in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Shionogi to market U.S. antifibrotic drug in Japan.

text.p: Shionogi and Co Ltd said on Friday that it had agreed with Marnac Inc of the United States to develop and market the U.S. venture firm's antifibrotic drug in Japan.

The drug, Pirfenidone, which is currently going through phase two and three of three-stage clinical trials in the United States, is expected to be effective in treating enlargement of the prostate, cirrhosis of the liver and chronic nephritis.
The drug could also prove effective in the treatment of Alzheimer's disease in the future, a Shionogi spokesman said.
Clinical trials in Japan will likely begin in the business year starting in April 1998, he said.
Shionogi is a major pharmaceuticals maker.
